name: AI Fundamentals for Researchers
outcome: Identify suitable AI approaches, their limitations and when AI is not appropriate.
description: An accessible introduction to artificial intelligence, traditional machine learning, deep learning and generative AI. Explore research use cases, distinguish model capabilities from limitations, and decide when conventional methods are more appropriate.
external: No technical prerequisites; basic digital literacy.
learn: Distinguish ML, deep learning and generative AI
Identify suitable research use cases and non-AI alternatives
Recognize uncertainty, bias and data protection risks
modules: Research use cases and decision exercise
moduleDescriptions: Compare classification, regression, deep learning and generative tasks using research examples.
Recognize unreliable outputs, distribution shift and the limits of model predictions.
Choose an AI or conventional method for a small scientific problem.
Check data sensitivity, bias and accountability; record your decision.
